native_close.scope: only launcher-owned Popen can attest wait/reap; reopened controller only requests closure

owned_scene_start_reserved.scope: conservative slot reservation before Popen; failed Popen is not silently refunded

requests.cache_scope: repeated request is not assumed a hit; existing result/pair cache flags in task_work are authoritative

context.certificate_scope: Certificate category with local evidence when available. Transverse evidence identifies current captured triangles and approximates their boundary crossing; the exact midpoint is on both boundaries, not in their shared volume interior. Neither a boundary location nor surface distance is penetration depth.
context.identity_scope: Object and instance IDs belong to this captured document/snapshot.

requests.timing_scope: product Peer elapsed includes its existing directory/TX/RX/JSON/audit work; owner interval includes Peer and overlaps it; never add the two as independent costs
requests.worker_event_scope: received worker request events whose start falls in owner tool interval; excludes initial/final safety reads and close, unreceived/transport attempts not inferred
